'''Ssseeeeseetek''' was a [[Galidyn]] [[Steward (Galidyn)|Steward]], ruling over one of the underground Galidyn [[City/Legends|cities]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Fyodos]]. At four thousand years old, Ssseeeeseetek was the oldest and strongest being on the planet, and was widely respected.
